 "rationale": "Two gain stages with moderate L give over 68 dB; a single stage cannot reach it with good swing. GBW=gm1/2piCc with Cc~0.7p needs gm1~0.35mS (tail ~50uA). Setting gm7>=2.2*gm1*CL/Cc gives I7~230uA for PM. Rz>1/gm7 adds a LHP zero. Budget: 10+50+230 uA ≈ 520 uW. The CS output stage swings within ~0.2 V of the rails. SR=Itail/Cc≈70 V/us."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),   # input pair L
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),    # PMOS mirror load and M7 (same L, same gm/Id -> no systematic offset)
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 13),        # PMOS gm/Id (M3/M4/M7)
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS bias mirror L (MB, M5, M8)
    "gmidn": (12, 8, 15),        # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Itail": (50e-6, 30e-6, 90e-6),
    "I7":    (230e-6, 150e-6, 320e-6),
    "Cc":    (0.7e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.2e-12),
    "kz":    (1.6, 1.0, 3.0),    # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    # Devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It/2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It/2, vds=1.1)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)          # sinks IREF
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)           # tail
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)             # inverting side -> diode
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)              # non-inverting side -> 1st-stage out
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)               # 2nd stage CS (inverting)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)           # sink load
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "xz", "vout", Cc)

    # Predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + c1 * cout + Cc * cout))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) / 2
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "swing": swing}
